def match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    """
    Implements a recursive backtracking algorithm for regex matching.
    Supports literal characters, '.', '*', and '+'.
    Utilizes memoization to optimize performance for overlapping subproblems.
    """

    memo = {}

    def is_match(p: str, t: str) -> bool:
        if (p, t) in memo:
            return memo[(p, t)]
        
        if not p:  # If the pattern is empty
            return not t  # Only a match if text is also empty
        
        first_match = bool(t) and (p[0] == t[0] or p[0] == '.')

        # Handle '*' wildcard
        if len(p) >= 2 and p[1] == '*':
            result = (is_match(p[2:], t) or 
                      (first_match and is_match(p, t[1:])))
        # Handle '+' wildcard
        elif len(p) >= 2 and p[1] == '+':
            result = (first_match and 
                      (is_match(p[2:], t[1:]) or 
                       is_match(p, t[1:])))
        else:  # Match literal characters
            result = first_match and is_match(p[1:], t[1:])

        memo[(p, t)] = result
        return result

    return is_match(pattern, text)

def match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    """
    Implements a recursive backtracking algorithm for regex matching.
    Supports literal characters, '.', '*', and '+'.
    Utilizes memoization to optimize performance for overlapping subproblems.
    """

    memo = {}

    def is_match(p: str, t: str) -> bool:
        if (p, t) in memo:
            return memo[(p, t)]
        
        if not p:  # If the pattern is empty
            return not t  # Match only if text is also empty
        
        first_match = bool(t) and (p[0] == t[0] or p[0] == '.')

        if len(p) >= 2 and p[1] == '*':
            result = (is_match(p[2:], t) or  # Zero occurrence
                      (first_match and is_match(p, t[1:])))  # One or more occurrences
        elif len(p) >= 2 and p[1] == '+':
            result = (first_match and 
                      (is_match(p[2:], t[1:]) or  # One occurrence followed by more
                       is_match(p, t[1:])))  # Continue same pattern for more matches
        else:  # Match literal characters
            result = first_match and is_match(p[1:], t[1:])

        memo[(p, t)] = result
        return result

    return is_match(pattern, text)
